description: This file defines a VoiceWakeManager class responsible for voice wake word detection and speech recognition on iOS using Apple's Speech framework and AVAudioEngine. It manages permissions, audio sessions, audio data buffers, and recognition tasks, providing methods to start, stop, suspend, and resume listening for wake words, as well as handling recognition results.

classes.name: AudioBufferQueue
classes.description: A thread-safe queue managing AVAudioPCMBuffer instances, used for buffering audio data.

methods.name: enqueueCopy
methods.description: Enqueues a deep copy of an AVAudioPCMBuffer into the queue.

methods.name: drain
methods.description: Retrieves and clears all buffers from the queue.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Removes all buffers from the queue.

classes.name: VoiceWakeManager
classes.description: Main class responsible for managing voice wake word detection and speech recognition, including permission handling, audio session configuration, and recognition lifecycle.

methods.name: makeAudioTapEnqueueCallback
methods.description: Creates a callback for audio tap that enqueues audio buffers into a queue.

methods.name: deepCopy
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of an AVAudioPCMBuffer, supporting different channel data formats.

methods.name: configureAudioSession
methods.description: Configures the AVAudioSession for recording and playback with appropriate options.

methods.name: requestMicrophonePermission
methods.description: Requests microphone permission asynchronously with a timeout.

methods.name: requestSpeechPermission
methods.description: Requests speech recognition permission asynchronously with a timeout.

methods.name: startRecognition
methods.description: Sets up and starts the speech recognition process, including audio engine and recognition task.

methods.name: tearDownRecognitionPipeline
methods.description: Stops recognition and releases related resources.

methods.name: extractCommand
methods.description: Parses the transcript to detect wake words and extract commands.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Begins listening for wake words with permission checks and platform support considerations.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops listening and disables the wake manager.

methods.name: suspendForExternalAudioCapture
methods.description: Temporarily suspends recognition for external audio capture, returning true if suspension occurred.

methods.name: resumeAfterExternalAudioCapture
methods.description: Resumes recognition after external audio capture if previously suspended.
